summary_en: This study tests tulmimetostat (DZR123) given with JSB462 (luxdegalutamide) in men with progressive metastatic castrate resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC). In Part 2, the combination is compared with standard of care. Tulmimetostat and JSB462 are both given once a day (QD); the length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is Phase I/II.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tulmimetostat (DZR123) combinado con JSB462 (luxdegalutamida) en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración (mCRPC) progresivo. En la Parte 2, la combinación se compara con el tratamiento estándar. Tulmimetostat y JSB462 se administran una vez al día (QD); la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El resultado principal que se mide no se indica; el estudio es de Fase I/II.
who_for: Adult men aged 18 years or older.
Prostate adenocarcinoma without neuroendocrine or small cell features.
At least one metastatic lesion on recent imaging.
Progressive mCRPC with castrate testosterone levels.
Progressed on at least one prior second-generation ARPI (Part 2: taxane-naive in mCRPC).
not_for: Previous treatment with any PRC2 or EED inhibitor.
Previous treatment with an AR-targeting protein degrader.
Known hypersensitivity to study treatment components.
Investigational agent within 28 days before study entry.
Prior radioligand therapy in mCRPC (Part 1a is an exception).
